extras.reason: The batching change converts the entire remaining deque before slicing on each successful batch. For a large backlog N and fixed batch size B, copies total N+(N-B)+... = O(N squared/B), whereas the base drains in one pass. The stated successful successive-batch trigger and allocation/copying impact are supported by source. This unseeded performance regression remains outside the frozen truth denominator.
